governance.note: The 2026-07-07-nyiso-56-measured-zonal keeper recipe VERBATIM with exactly ONE change, and it is a MEASURED-DATA change, not a tuned parameter (rules 12/13, no new free parameter): nyiso_dynamic_reserve_requirements=True - the in-LP energy+reserve co-optimization's static published locational reserve requirements are replaced by the MEASURED as-enforced hourly series (Ask-B intake, data/raw/NYISO-AS/requirements/NYISO_reserve_requirements_{2023,2024,2025}.csv, derived by the frozen scripts/derive_nyiso_reserve_requirements_hourly.py): published LRR base with the SENY 30-min HOURLY STEP SCHEDULE (1,300 HB0-5 / 1,550 HB6 / 1,800 HB7-21 / 1,550 HB22 / 1,300 HB23 - the static 1,300 MW the RCPF design enforced was the overnight floor, 500 MW low in every peak hour) x TSA-window zeroing from the B2 MIS event logs (185/227/120 h in 2023/24/25; v2021+ rule: NYC 10T/30T and SENY 30T requirements drop to zero during Thunderstorm Alerts). Rule-13 admissibility: the series regenerates for a forward year as the published static base plus the published condition rules applied to forward states, and responds to changed conditions. The measured reserve PRICES (NYISO_as_{rt,da}_{year}.csv) are the validation target and are NEVER read by the loader (loader raises if the file is absent - no silent static fallback). The derived series remains a documented LOWER BOUND on the as-enforced requirement in non-TSA hours until the B1 formal NYISO data request lands (condition-varying largest-contingency / forecast-uncertainty increments are not freely published). This closes the data-blocked half of the keeper's open item (2): #1344 is now driven by measured data (B2+B3); the B1 residual stays open.
governance.residuals_note: A/B RESULT (vs the nyiso-56 keeper at the same HEAD, v2.4 load-weighted price basis): a metrics WASH on the price level/shape with a real added RT-like scarcity tail. C3a 2023 PASS (RT basis; DA diag -4.8% vs keeper -4.2%), 2024 -13.2% (keeper -13.1%), 2025 -15.7% (keeper -15.5%); C3b 2024 NRMSE 0.221 (keeper 0.220), 2025 0.215 (keeper 0.215); C3c >$300 model tail 2023 23h (keeper 21h; RT actual 10h), 2024 1h (keeper 0h; RT actual 12h - the mild year gains its first modeled scarcity hour), 2025 25h (keeper 14h; RT actual 42h - closes ~26% of the remaining RT-tail gap; on the DA-expressible gate 25h vs 12h DA = 2.08x, marginally outside [0.5,2.0] - the same G-20a scoring-basis artifact the keeper ledgers for 2023, see the price_tail entries). C1 fuel-mix 14/14 PASS, C2 PASS, C4 PASS, C7 PASS, C8 clean PASS via the v2.2 grounded-above-budget escalation (ST_GAS 30.3/44.5/38.0% forced, all binding mechanisms clear the cited D-4 windows, D-1 r 0.948-0.956) - no load-bearing regression. C5a CO2: the 2024 commercial-band caveat clears; 2025 reads +8.6% (commercial band). Per rule 1 the mechanism is kept on its measured basis (measured hourly requirement > static stand-in - the exact promotion logic of nyiso-56's measured load shares), NOT on residual movement. Zero-forcing ablation twin registered alongside (2026-07-10-nyiso-59-dynamic-rr-ablation).

_open_items: (1) 2024 (mild year) + 2025 DEEP (>$300) price tail still under the RT actual - next structural lever remains downstate import discipline: the MEASURED NYC locality import limit is 2,875 MW (capacity-deliverability) vs the model's 3,900 MW Dunwoodie-South energy-TTC estimate; apply in the summer-peak window as the Zone-K TSL (#1345) does for LI. (2) #1344 PARTIALLY CLOSED this run: the B2+B3 measured reconstruction now drives the in-LP hourly requirement; the residual is the B1 formal data request (condition-varying largest-contingency / forecast-uncertainty increments; the derived series is a lower bound in non-TSA hours). (3) SENY 30-min requirement MW is no longer a placeholder (B3 published hourly step schedule in force 2023-2025); the RS4 primary-PDF unfetchability note is superseded by the dated LRR postings intake. (4) C3c is scored on the DA-expressible basis (G-20a) - the RT-like tail the co-opt produces (23/1/25 h) is not credited until settlement-price scoring lands; 2025 trips the DA gate at 2.08x while sitting 17h UNDER the RT actual. (5) capacity-deliverability clean partition still requires curation before a solve (zonal-shares has a raw fallback); CI replay of this recipe OOMs GitHub-hosted runners in regenerate_clean (4 attempts 2026-07-10) - solve locally with >= 15 GB + swap.
